newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London mixed to easier.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London mixed to easier.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were steady to slightly lower in light trade on Wednesday as investors continued to sit on their hands, dealers said.
"The market in Hong Kong has not been volatile enough of late to trigger any action in London," said one dealer.

The Hang Seng London Reference index eased 14.80 points to close at 14,688.93. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index fell 88.44 points to finish at 14,703.73, with profit-taking in utility stocks and a solid performance from the recently oversold property shares featuring.
But dealers said that what action there was in Hong Kong failed to spill over into London and they partly blamed the summer season for the low turnover.
Even HSBC Holdings was a victim of the lacklustre session. The heavyweight banking group rose just 50 cents to HK$243.50 .
